description: This Python file contains functions related to regional restrictions and transaction logging for an ERP system, specifically handling permissions and logging behavior based on regional settings when dealing with document deletions and submissions.

methods.name: check_deletion_permission(doc, method)
methods.description: Checks if deletion permission is allowed based on the region and document status; throws an error if deletion is not permitted for certain regions.

methods.name: create_transaction_log(doc, method)
methods.description: Creates and inserts a transaction log for a document when applicable, logging the document's data for legal reasons when the region is France or Germany.
